title: Halting persists for longer choice words
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with $K$ work tapes and Boolean symbols, let $C$ be a configuration on a fixed Boolean input, and let $n\in\mathbb{N}$. If every choice word of length exactly $n$ takes $M$ from $C$ to a halting configuration, then every choice word of length at least $n$ also takes $M$ from $C$ to a halting configuration.
